title: 炼油厂98%利用率：库存却见底，农民先扛价
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Paul Sankiew, Sankiew Research, is joining us around the table. He writes the following, an industry running at 98% capacity is risky.
segments.zh: Sankey研究公司的Paul Sankey加入我们圆桌讨论。他写道，一个产能利用率达98%的行业是有风险的。

segments.en: Paul Giants is now for more. Paul Gamonik, how close are we for a big problem?
segments.zh: Paul Giants现在更多。Paul Gamonik，我们离大问题有多近？

segments.en: One refinery going down. So if we have a major refining accident here, which, thankfully, we haven't had hurricanes as yet this season, and we're getting quite deep into it, that was one concern.
segments.zh: 一家炼油厂停产。所以如果这里发生重大炼油事故，幸运的是，本季至今没有飓风，而且我们已经进入较深阶段，那曾是一个担忧。

segments.en: The biggest down time we ever had in U.S. refining was winter storm Uri, which was in 21 in February, 21.
segments.zh: 美国炼油业历史上最长的停工是冬季风暴Uri，发生在21年2月。

segments.en: So that is still out there, depending on how you view El Nino. But in fact, with inventories, I think, this little inventories are at operational minimums now.
segments.zh: 所以这仍然存在，取决于你如何看待厄尔尼诺。但事实上，就库存而言，我认为这些库存现在处于运营最低水平。

segments.en: We've never seen them go lower than this. That's the observation. So this is the lowest they've ever gotten, as we would say.
segments.zh: 我们从未见过它们比这更低。这就是观察结果。所以这是它们有史以来最低的，正如我们所说。

segments.en: And as a result, any major outage in refining, particularly in the U.S. would be extremely damaging and give you more upside right at harvest time.
segments.zh: 因此，任何重大炼油中断，尤其是在美国，都将极具破坏性，并在收获季节给你带来更多上行空间。

segments.en: So one of our concerns here is that the farmers are pricing elastic. They have to harvest, and so they're going to have to pay this price.
segments.zh: 所以我们这里的一个担忧是，农民的价格弹性。他们必须收获，所以他们不得不支付这个价格。

segments.en: And that's tough. And as you can see, the president has tuned in that the problem is diesel, not how much oil Saudi is getting out.
segments.zh: 这很艰难。正如你所看到的，总统已经指出问题在于柴油，而不是沙特开采多少石油。

segments.en: Although, of course, that will bring down the price of crude. So you mentioned the farmers.
segments.zh: 当然，尽管这会降低原油价格。所以你提到了农民。

segments.en: They're the ones that are pushing the president to actually, or the Congress, to announce an embargo on diesel.
segments.zh: 他们正推动总统或国会宣布柴油出口禁令。

segments.en: Walk us through what that would mean for refineries if we would see an export ban.
segments.zh: 请讲讲如果实施出口禁令，对炼油厂意味着什么。

segments.en: Well, there's the unintended consequences, right?
segments.zh: 嗯，会有意想不到的后果，对吧？
